scope: Symbi OS-wide security properties on the exact signed Fedora Atomic image. Design models, source references, fixtures and build-input checks are not runtime qualification.

controls.title: Complete mediation of agent effects
controls.threat: An agent reaches a file, process, network endpoint or service without the Cedar gate deciding the prepared action
controls.invariant: INV-1: No agent side effect occurs without a gate decision, and model output never grants authority
controls.owner: Symbiont gate, symbi-run, symbi-egressd, symbi-modeld, symbi-servicesd, and symbi-browserd
limitations: Qualification drivers and strict report validators exist, but the exact installed OS routes have not all passed native qualification
Desktop launchers and service brokers are not implemented
No OS-wide escape suite result is attached

controls.title: Only physical human acts create or widen grants
controls.threat: An agent, application, voice command or replayed approval creates, widens or extends its own authority
controls.invariant: INV-2: Grants are created, widened or extended only by a physical trusted-path confirmation or human designation act
limitations: The bounded models are design evidence, not an implemented trusted path
A composed physical approval to exact grant-use model and runtime trace remain required
No compositor, trustd or grant broker runtime qualification is attached

controls.title: Revocation acknowledgement is final
controls.threat: An in-flight or cached action completes after the user is told its grant is revoked
controls.invariant: INV-3: After revocation is acknowledged, no action under that grant completes
controls.owner: Symbiont gate, symbi-egressd, symbi-modeld, and symbi-grantd
limitations: The bounded revoke model assumes cancellation prevents later external completion
Each network executor still needs an observable completion and acknowledgement contract
No real concurrent revoke trace or timed integration result is attached

controls.title: Trusted surfaces exclude synthetic input
controls.threat: Synthetic input reaches a trusted surface and is mistaken for a human grant action
controls.invariant: INV-4: Synthetic input never reaches a trusted-path surface
limitations: The current model constrains receipt minting and does not explicitly model delivery to the surface
An explicit delivery-exclusion model and synthetic-input fuzzing remain required
No compositor or screen-capture runtime result is attached

controls.title: Durable signed journal precedes each released effect
controls.threat: A crash, reorder or unsigned record permits an effect without durable attributable evidence
controls.invariant: INV-5: Every executed action is hash-chained, signed and synced before its effect is released
controls.owner: Symbiont protected journal, symbi-egressd, symbi-modeld, symbi-grantd, and symbi-servicesd
limitations: The retained runtime fixture and validator preparation do not establish the installed OS behavior
OS brokers and grant events are not implemented
No real crash trace from an exact image is attached

controls.title: Provider and OAuth secrets stay outside workers
controls.threat: A worker reads a credential from its environment, files, memory or inherited descriptors
controls.invariant: INV-6: Provider keys and OAuth tokens stay in trusted stores and are injected only at a trusted egress boundary
limitations: The OS brokers are not implemented
The proposed subscription-token exception conflicts with the invariant and remains unresolved
No worker canary or memory, file, environment and descriptor inspection is attached

controls.title: Workers have only brokered network exits
controls.threat: A worker bypasses the policy brokers through a host, namespace or container network path
controls.invariant: INV-7: An agent network namespace reaches only the egress and model broker sockets
controls.owner: symbi-run, symbi-egressd, symbi-modeld, and worker-namespace integration
limitations: Native qualification on the exact installed image is incomplete
Workspace-mode proxy confinement is not implemented
No OS-wide direct-network escape suite result is attached

controls.title: Confidential sessions stay on local destinations
controls.threat: Caller-controlled or stale routing metadata sends confidential content to a remote model, API or voice service
controls.invariant: INV-8: A client-confidential session never sends content to a remote model, API or voice service
controls.owner: symbi-modeld, symbi-egressd, and the voice adapter
limitations: The bounded model assumes authenticated destination metadata
The trusted source and vocabulary for session class remain unresolved
No OS broker or voice runtime result is attached

controls.title: Equivalent service requests receive one decision
controls.threat: A request denied over one transport succeeds through a browser, shared tab or alternate API route
controls.invariant: INV-9: API, agent-browser and shared-tab forms of one request receive the same Cedar decision
limitations: The service and browser brokers are not implemented
No transport-normalization model exists
No cross-transport decision trace is attached

controls.title: Freeze acknowledgement stops all agent completion
controls.threat: A queued, in-flight or remotely accepted action completes while the user believes the system is frozen
controls.invariant: INV-10: After freeze acknowledgement, no agent action completes until a trusted resume
controls.owner: symbi-trustd and every OS effect executor
limitations: The bounded model assumes cancellation drains kernel and network work
Each executor still needs an observable completion and acknowledgement contract
No real trace establishes the 500 millisecond target

controls.title: Skill manifests can only reduce effective authority
controls.threat: A skill manifest, instruction or runtime dependency adds authority outside the human grant
controls.invariant: INV-11: Effective authority is the intersection of agent grants and the skill manifest
controls.owner: Symbiont gate and the OS skill loader
limitations: The current Cedar fixtures establish schema behavior and default denial only
The skill manifest and grant intersection are not implemented
No property-check or runtime denial report is attached

controls.title: Trusted artifacts are immutable and authenticated
controls.threat: A mutable, unsigned or substituted image, contract, skill, model or data artifact enters a trusted path
controls.invariant: INV-12: Images, contracts, manifests, skills, model weights and wake-word models are pinned and signature-checked before use
controls.owner: OS image pipeline, Store, symbi-modeld, and the voice service
limitations: Several authenticated inputs and fail-closed intake paths exist, but no release image is qualified
Some selected desktop payload closure and source-RPM evidence remain open
No single exact report covers signed build, update, rollback and every named artifact class

controls.title: Project configuration only narrows authority
controls.threat: A malicious repository changes provider, routing, sandbox or egress controls
controls.invariant: INV-13: Repository-local configuration cannot widen providers, routing, sandbox or egress
limitations: The desktop launcher and profiles are not implemented
The pinned runtime has narrower source/control separation that is not OS-wide evidence
No malicious-project matrix is attached

controls.title: Voice never grants authority
controls.threat: Replayed, synthesized or injected speech approves a grant or releases confidential audio without policy
controls.invariant: INV-14: Voice cannot approve or grant, and audio stays local until wake and policy decisions allow release
controls.owner: Voice adapter, symbi-trustd, and local audio service
limitations: Voice is optional and not implemented
The audio-capture isolation mechanism remains unresolved
No replay, self-wake, injection or trusted-path refusal result is attached
